name: Prosperity Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Prosperity Real Estate Investment Trust is the first private sector real estate investment trust to be listed on The stock exchange of Hong Kong Limited on 16 December 2005. Prosperity REIT owns a diverse portfolio of seven high-quality properties in the decentralized business districts of Hong Kong, with a total gross rentable area of about 1.28 million sq. ft.. Prosperity Real Estate Investment Trust was established and incorporated on November 29, 2005 in Hong Kong.
